_help: EDIT ME. Everything players see comes from this file. After saving, press 'Reload game.json' on the host page (no restart needed). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
title: A very botanical meeting
rules:
Welcome to the botany club. The town of Ravenholts #1 botany club! come chat about the plants or whatever.
The host will tell you when you may use your abilities. Stay in character!
_phaseLabels: Rename the phases players see. Keys must stay: lobby, discussion, action, voting, ended.

phaseLabels.lobby: Waiting for the game to start
phaseLabels.action: Night falls: use your abilities when the host calls you

_teams: Team ids used by characters below. 'color' tints the badge on the player's card.
_defaultCharacterId: Anyone left over after a random deal gets this character.

characters._help: COPY THIS BLOCK to add a character. id must be unique, lowercase, no spaces.
characters.name: Cameron Chase
characters.tagline: A doctor with a secret hatred of people. Friendly at first, but killer second.
characters.personality: Charming, sarcastic, and a little witty. always patient with others but has a tendency to make snyde comments behind peoples backs.
characters.description: Early 20s, Good at first impressions and loves to chat. Messes up names quite constantly in order to seem more clumsy
characters.story: You serve as a part time front desk worker at the local hospital, helping to check people in and make sure that all the doctors get to there patients. You always make a stop at the bakery on the way home to chat with barnelby.

extra.title: Your alibi

characters.personality: Goofy witch, hobbles around alot but is very wholesome and funny
characters.description: late 50s, Very silly and funny. Loves to brew and bake, but also catch butterflys in a cute way.
characters.story: You love to talk with others about witch things like brewing potions, black cats, and evil curses. But also baking and food!

abilities.label: Witch curse
abilities.description: Place a curse on one other person. That person cant use there action tommarow.

characters.name: Callaway Barnelby
characters.tagline: A trusty entromologist who secretly saves people in there freetime.
characters.personality: Warm, anxious, a chronic over-explainer. Gets flustered when accused.
characters.description: Late 30s. Warm smile. Goofy demeanor, A little anxious.
characters.story: Your well known in town for being the local crazy who loves to get close with bugs. But in your free time, you study to become a doctor to help others instead.
characters.secrets: You may NOT protect the same person two nights in a row (host enforces this).

abilities.label: Protect a patient
abilities.description: Choose someone to shield from harm tonight. You may choose yourself.

characters.name: Shawn franks
characters.tagline: A make believe psychic who really is just good at noticing the small things and being very unspecific. A better detective than most however.
characters.personality: Constantly sarcastic and witty, playing everything like there too cool to be here.
characters.description: Goofy, charismatic, and overall a woman charmer and lover. Best friends with Gus Spencer
characters.story: After being invited to the governers ball, you decide to do your favorite party trick of pretending the spirits tell you about a person. But can the spirits save you now?
characters.secrets: The host will privately tell you the result of each investigation.

abilities.label: Investigate a suspect
abilities.description: Pick someone. The host will message you what you learn.

characters.name: Carlton Lasiter
characters.tagline: A tired detective who really just wants to be cool.
characters.personality: Stone cold serious, Incredibly suspicious of everyone
characters.description: Early 30s. Mogs alot, very serious and apathetic.
characters.story: You've always looked for that small town murder plot, even though you failed out of the acadmey and now work as a basic accountant. Some part of you has always loves witty cop movies, and dream of being the star of one.
characters.secrets: If you shoot a townsperson, the guilt will be on you. The host decides what happens.

abilities.label: Take the shot
abilities.description: You only have THREE bullets for the whole game.

characters.name: Gus Spencer
characters.tagline: No powers except a hatred of shawns nonsense and extreme anxiety
characters.personality: Late 20s, Very jumpy, Shawns best friend. More serious than shawn but will jump into his arms at the first mention of a ghost
characters.description: Serious, No non-sense, and definitley afriad of danger. Best friends with shawn
characters.story: You work as a pharmasudical sales rep as your full time job, but your part time job is helping shawn pretend to be a psychic by giving him your smarts to help figure people out

abilities.label: Investigate a suspect
abilities.description: Pick someone. The host will message you what you learn.

characters.name: Barnelby Promescur
characters.tagline: A love of sweet treats and breads alike
characters.personality: Very cheery, Very loving. think of a very sweet man who just likes to help.
characters.description: Late 40s, A baker who owns a small shop in town that serves the community. Everyones grandpa
characters.story: You own a local bakery in town that serves pastrys and breads. You work with your rebelious nephew Max who wants to be a big chef like gordon ramsey and hates baking. Your favorite regular is cameron who always comes in to chat after work.

abilities.label: Free treat
abilities.description: Bake a treat for a friend! May have an effect

characters.name: Max Promescur
characters.tagline: A Rebelious youngerster who hates baking
characters.personality: Rebelious mean and snyde. think of a classic rebelious teen
characters.description: You live in Ravenholt. You have a job, neighbors and suspicions.
characters.story: You run a local bakery with your uncle Barnelby in town that serves pastrys and breads. You someday wish to leave and go become a top chef like gordon ramsey, but for now yours stuck tending to bread or whatever a bakery sells.

abilities.label: Taste test
abilities.description: Cook for a friend! May have an effect

characters.name: Vlab orchovsky
characters.tagline: The muffin man? No, the russian man
characters.personality: Just be really russian. I mean accent and everything
characters.description: Your the town drunk, and you love to be the life of the party. Very russian life of the party. Just incredibly russian
characters.story: Your a beer salesman who settled in this town because you just love one specific bar here (you can make it up). Everywhere you go you bring the party.
characters.secrets: You are a neutral, however you may choose your win condition by picking either the mafia side or the town side. Go to noah to choose

abilities.label: Have a drink
abilities.description: Give a drink to someone! Changes who they target.

characters.name: Ordinary Citizen
characters.tagline: No powers. A lot of opinions.
characters.personality: Make this up! Pick a trade, a quirk and a grudge from the host's list.
